provenance.inputs_summary: Aspen integrated ci_* runs at the kinetic T_op; python flowsheet at kinetic X elsewhere

basis.feed: 100 kmol/h liquid NH3 (0.2 mol% H2O), 20 bar, 95 % NH3 conversion for every catalyst, PSA recovery 0.85
basis.operating_temperature: from kinetics: W(T) for the conversion target; T_opt = argmin LCOH over 470-760 degC (5 K)
basis.heat_import: temperature-feasible import after FEHE and tail-gas firing (amcrax.heat_integration config (c); without FEHE: problem table of feed + reaction vs flue gas), dT_min 20 K
basis.furnace: supplementary NH3 at furnace efficiency 0.85 plus 2% thermal loss of reactor + trim heater duty (assumptions)
basis.economics: amcrax.economics.singapore.evaluate, grey 450 USD/t, catalyst W*price/lifetime (2 yr)
